summary: This bill mandates that all aircraft required to transmit Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast Out (ADS-B Out) must also be equipped with and operate Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast In (ADS-B In) technology by December 31, 2031, while also narrowing exceptions for government aircraft to turn off ADS-B Out and requiring various reports and audits to enhance aviation safety and transparency.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates several new reviews, audits, and the establishment of an FAA office, which would likely incur additional government spending. While not the primary focus, these administrative requirements contribute to increased expenditure.
